toolchain_environment.incident: First build of this image (2026-08-01, prior session) was later found corrupted after the host machine hit a physical disk-full condition ('exec: input/output error' on every container invocation). Diagnosed via docker system df / re-running a plain ubuntu:24.04 container (worked) vs zgw-host-tools:s0 (failed). Fixed by `docker rmi -f`, `docker builder prune -a -f`, and a `--no-cache` rebuild from the same Dockerfile; rebuilt image verified working before reuse. No repository source files were affected by the crash (git diff/status confirmed clean of code changes both before and after).
